text_ru: Взять семенной заём: {resource} — {amount} т. Вернуть к повороту года {amount_back} т.
meaning: Seed received now and the in-kind repayment due at the year turn
intent: Show the actual price before the existing order is confirmed
keep: Same resource; tonnes for both amounts; actual negotiated mark-up rather than a hardcoded factor
binding_note: Proposed key; amount and amount_back are numeric tonnes WITHOUT unit suffix; obtain repayment from the authoritative quote including any reputation discount; do not infer it from displayed rounded amount

text_ru: Для ближайшего сева не хватает семян. Выберите «Взять семенной заём» или пересмотрите севооборот под запас. Без скидки вернуть нужно на пятую часть больше. Непогашенный долг растёт каждый год.
meaning: Seed shortage has an existing district loan alternative with a normal one-fifth mark-up
intent: Name the order by its opening words and warn of carry-over
keep: One-fifth is the undiscounted rate; not a claim that discounts do not exist
binding_note: Existing tip; matching order wording is essential; the order quote shows the actual return; no button or new operation is implemented by this delivery

text_ru: В конце года заём гасят из остатка сверх плана и семян. Непогашенный долг перейдёт на следующий год: без скидки вернуть нужно на пятую часть больше.
meaning: Unpaid in-kind debt is carried and marked up again after protected requirements
intent: Replace an opaque new mark-up with its ordinary numerical meaning
keep: Plan and seeds protected; unpaid balance rather than original whole loan; discounted rate may differ
binding_note: Existing tip; do not change repayment priority or apply the rate again to an already marked-up snapshot

text_ru: Перенесённый долг: {resource} — {amount}. К возврату {amount_back} из урожая {year} года.
meaning: The carried loan row names the amount owed and the actual repayment amount for the harvest year
intent: Keep the existing ledger entry and make repayment explicit
keep: Existing resource and year bindings; amounts here include their units unlike the order quote
binding_note: Retain existing amount kind=amount with unit; new amount_back also includes unit and comes from authoritative carried-debt accounting; no second multiplication if the snapshot already includes the mark-up

meaning: Current consecutive failed annual plans against this avatar's effective trial threshold
intent: Let the player read the count between warning scenes
keep: Consecutive not lifetime failures; actual avatar-specific limit not hardcoded three
binding_note: Show on the year's book plan page from the first failure; after a fulfilled year render n=0 in the established row; layer owns visibility and must use the effective threshold

text_ru: Годовой план сорван {limit} {limit}|plural(one=год,few=года,many=лет,other=лет) подряд. Начинается разбор дела.
meaning: The consecutive-plan threshold has triggered the established ending procedure
intent: Name the effective count without claiming a verdict or completed court transfer
keep: Avatar-specific limit; consecutive years; signal then commission then case then court
binding_note: Existing event; new limit placeholder must be supplied by its producer from the saved trigger; not from a later mutable setting; unrelated ending causes do not select this line
